Name: (AT) Bear Statue to Wriothesley
Author: prerona2411
Description:
Do you like Wriothesley? No? Well, I do.
This started out as something I was drawing for shits and giggles, and then I got too into it. So I thought 'Why not post it here for any other potential Wriothesley enjoyers?' and now this mod exists.

How to get Worcestershire - I mean, Wriothesley into your game:

1) Have Alternative Textures installed
2) Buy the paint bucket from Robin
3) Use it on the Bear Statue
4) ???
5) Get good luck in your Genshin pulls*

*[i][size=1](Disclaimer: the author of this mod is not responsible for losses of 50/50)

[/size][/i]Will I add other characters to this? 

Ehhhh I don't know, if I'm in the mood and if the character's outfits don't decrease my sanity while converting into pixel art.
